_comment: Hand-curated versification corrections merged OVER the auto map (scripts/build_versification_map.py) at load time. ru_synodal now reproduces bible.by's authentic Synodal (Septuagint) psalm numbering and carries its own auto-map block generated by scripts/build_ru_synodal_versification.py — it no longer needs manual corrections here. The ru_nrt entries below correct curated Masoretic refs to ru_nrt's Septuagint coordinate where the auto-aligner (which was aligned to the OLD, defective ru_synodal anchor) produced an off-by-one: 'ps 32:8' and 'ps 91:2' were mis-mapped to the next verse; the rest are title-shifted psalms. All verified by hand against the verse text (the same fix applies to ru_synodal, since both share Septuagint numbering).
